activity_id.description: Required intervals.icu activity ID whose distance, altitude, time, heart-rate, and power streams are analyzed.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

include_full.description: Accepted for analyzer compatibility; climb analysis never returns source arrays or a series field.

max_bridged_elevation_loss_m.description: Maximum downhill loss allowed across a bridged shelf, in meters; bounded 0..1000.

max_gap_distance_m.description: Maximum distance gap allowed when bridging adjacent candidate runs, in meters; bounded 0..10000.

min_elevation_gain_m.description: Minimum net elevation gain for a final segment, in meters; bounded 0..100000.

min_grade_percent.description: Minimum inclusive average grade for a candidate climb, in percent; bounded 0.1..100.
